page.layout: One page of text, with verse stanzas, a heading, a short list of keywords and a smaller explanatory paragraph below. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. No marginal notes on this page; the strip at the left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: 2 Denuo, qui Christi fuerint per dogmata nati, Insontes mores obtinuisse decet. Fac colito proceres, populi qui sceptra gubernant. Nec pigeat forti pectore ferre crucem.
3 Coniungi leges diuino dogmate pandit. Sit tibi vita insons, sit pietatis amor. Nec moueat, si quae pro Christi nomine damna Eueniant: hic est vnica nempe salus.
4 Tollite uæsanæ fœdissima crimina vitæ, Quæ læthō Christus sustulit ante suo. Dispensēs digne diuini dona fauoris. Tristia constanti corde pericla feras.
5 Dogmata proponit sanctis seruanda ministris, Et iuuenum leges officiumque docet. Sint humiles animi & vigiles, sit sobria vita, Vt satanae possint tela nocere nihil.
main_text.head: BREVIVS.
CAPVT I.
main_text.p: Audi quid credas, quid speres, cingite lumbos, Sanguine, non auro suspisat agnus oues. 2 Bilis pellatur, lædit. nam vos genus estis Electum, cunctis detur honestus honos. 3 Commonet vxores pia Sara, pericula ferte. Ima petit Christus. Noe lauacra noua. 4 Defunctus vitiis benefac, si hospes amorem Serua, pro Christo vis tollerata beat. 5 Este sacerdotes tales, parete minores. Sobrietas vigiles, nam leo quaerit oues.
main_text.head: Breuissimè.
main_text.p: Vt Gramen, Alapis, Castam, Sobrij, Rugientis.{1}{2}{3}{4}{5}
main_text.head: Declaratio.
main_text.p: {1} Vt Garmen est omnis caro: v. 24. {2} Alapis cùm cæ-dimini toleratis. {3} Castam vestram conuersationem: v. 2. {4} Sobrii estote: v. 7. {5} Rugientis instar Leonis obambulat Satan v. 8.

page.notes: The stanza numbers (2, 3, 4, 5) stand in the left margin beside the verse and are printed as margin marks. The first stanza's mark is not clearly legible at the top; it is not transcribed as a number. The superscript numbers over the keywords are reference marks. "suspisat" is printed in this form and may be a misprint for "suspicat". "Garmen" in the explanatory note is as printed; it is probably a misprint for "Gramen". "X iiij" at the foot right is a gathering signature. The verse text is read from a small scan and is uncertain in places; doubtful letters are not marked individually.
